quote: Sometimes you hold on too tightly to shadows. You keep chasing ghosts through empty rooms. Memories fade before you catch them again. Every goodbye leaves a scar on time. Silence becomes the only language left behind. Let the past slip quietly from your hands. True peace begins the moment you finally surrender.
